verdict.rationale: Gitea is a forge with CI/CD (Gitea Actions), so connecting a Kubernetes cluster to deploy and monitor applications is a fair question. The evidence does not credit it. 'Kubernetes AutoScaling Runners' is about running CI runners on Kubernetes. Kubernetes compatibility is about where Gitea itself can be hosted. Argo CD appears only as a third-party integration. None of these is a documented first-party way to connect a cluster, including one behind a firewall or NAT, for deployment and monitoring.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can connect a Kubernetes cluster, including one behind a firewall or NAT, to deploy and monitor applications
